Class NameAllocator

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.gaia.processing.source.NameAllocator
public final class NameAllocator extends Object
Hands out Java identifiers that do not clash: each new name is the suggestion, made a valid identifier, with as many underscores appended as needed to differ from the keywords and the names already handed out. 
NameAllocator names = new NameAllocator();
for (Property property : properties) {
    names.newName(property.name(), property);
}
// Later, the same name for the same property.
builder.addStatement("this.$N = $N", names.get(property), names.get(property));

An allocator suits one scope; copy() gives a nested scope that sees the names of the enclosing one.

  • Method Details

    • toJavaIdentifier

      public static String toJavaIdentifier(String suggestion)
      Returns a valid Java identifier close to a suggestion: each character that cannot be in an identifier is replaced by an underscore, and an underscore goes first if the first character cannot start one. The result may still be a keyword.
      Parameters:
      suggestion - the suggestion, such as "first-name"
      Returns:
      the identifier, such as first_name

    • newName

      public String newName(String suggestion, Object tag)
      Returns a new name, attached to a tag to get it again later.
      Parameters:
      suggestion - the name to start from
      tag - what the name is for, such as the element or property it names
      Returns:
      a valid identifier, different from the keywords and every name handed out so far
      Throws:
